The '''Yuna Bore venom mine''' was a [[Venenit queshaaga|Quesh venom]] mine operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The mine was attacked and destroyed by the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Dracen]] during the [[Quesh war]].<ref name="Toxic Clash" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuna Bore venom mine appears on Quesh in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Toxic Clash" />
